graphics.caption: Folio 0034 Figure 1
graphics.title: Diagram for Proposition 12 showing two circles ABC and ADE touching externally at A
graphics.description: Circles ABC and ADE touching externally at A, proving that line joining centres F and G passes through point of contact A.
graphics.text_reference: I say that the straight line joined from F to G will pass through the point of contact at A. For suppose it does not, but, if possible, let it pass as FCDG...
